title: skills/ci-hygiene says the batch rules stay live until the cutover, while the merge tool has no batch path
why: A session reads a skill that says batching is live, while the tool it runs has no batch build or drop, so lanes and steps chase a flow that is gone.
source: Lane release-check-vs-batch-head 15:25 CST Nov 13 (measured on main 59da758a3: merge.py:4152; SKILL.md lines 59 and 86).
note: Filed 15:26 CST Nov 13. The skill and the tool disagree on whether batching is live. Whether the child repos still batch until the cutover (decision all-repos-switch-together) is unchecked. Overlaps the coordinator pick on drain-batch-measure and the ledger sweep of batch-only rows (backlog-drain). Past rulings not checked. Runner 11 starts no new batch and keeps its install by the coordinator hold. So the cutover has not reached the child repos: the skill text (batch rules live until the cutover) is true for them. The fix waits on the cutover for children, not a rewrite now. Note 15:29 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 15:29): SKILL.md line 59 stays true for children until the child-repo flow is ruled (page item 768; decision all-repos-switch-together, owner Q1 a, 2026-11-12 09:42 CST: no repo switches alone, state "target, not live" until act 4).
